dog.description_text:
Meet Charlene! With her sweet heart, gentle nature, and love for other dogs, this young pup is a total darling. Charlene lights up around canine companions. Whether they are big or small, she approaches fellow pups gently and thoroughly enjoys their company.

While she can be a bit shy around new people and places at first, her quiet curiosity shines through as she gets comfortable and slowly comes out of her shell. She views her crate as a cozy safe space where she happily goes to rest, and she is making steady progress learning her daily routine and leash skills.

Registered adopters interested in Charlene can email adopt@hbrdogs.com for more info. If you're not registered yet, do it today at hbrdogs.com!
